propositions: T15 overlay-derisk criterion must be authored as a rubric file with front-matter keys title, category, execution_mode (agentic), and dimension (overlay-derisk), and body containing S1-S3 applicability gates and checks (a)-(d) plus ANTI-FP paragraph verbatim.
T15 routing entry must be added to criteria_routing.json with exec: AGENT, facet: overlay-derisk, overlay_routing: llm, and applies_at suppress_types: [bug], inheriting default advisory posture.
T15 must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM within registry.py and pass all registry validators (check_registry_coverage, validate_packaged_routing, validate_criteria_guide).
The regenerated plan-review-criteria-guide.md must contain a T15 section with heading and all four checks (RISK NAMED, FAST OUT-OF-LOOP PROOF, PROVE-THEN-CODIFY, SCOPED CLEANUP) rendered in full.
The rebar explain T15 command must print the criterion name, exec tier AGENT, facet overlay-derisk, and the rubric body including all S1-S3 gates and checks.
